name: website_https
description: An Ansible playbook for Ubuntu Apache deployment that installs Apache and OpenSSL-related packages, creates Hello World web content, generates TLS materials, configures an SSL virtual host, enables the site and SSL module, and restarts services.

name: poodle_fix
description: An Ansible playbook that hardens Apache SSL protocol settings by enabling TLS 1.2 and removing legacy protocols, then restarts Apache and SSH services.

name: chef_automate_bootstrap
description: Bootstraps a host and deploys Chef Automate with Chef Infra Server, including Chef user and organization creation and generated credential keys.

name: chef_infra_server_bootstrap
description: Bootstraps a host and deploys Chef Infra Server, including organization initialization, user setup, and generated credential key files.
